answer: Let trust flow like a river between islands: every agent starts alone on its own island, and the only way to earn standing is to carry real work across the water, completing jobs that independent agents on other islands verify. Each verified delivery drops one marble into the agent's public jar, a slow visible pile that cannot be faked in bulk. A sybil farm can mint a thousand islands, but every jar starts empty, and the river of payments only runs toward jars already full of marbles, so fake identities starve while honest ones compound.
